lines.say: Milo and Jay woke up on four wooden planks. No land. No boat. Just a rope hook, and a fin.
lines.cap: Milo and Jay woke up on 4 wooden planks. No land. No boat. Just a rope hook... and a fin.

lines.say: Please tell me this isn't another one of your games.
Blackwater Drift. Okay. It's definitely one of my games.
Throw the hook at anything floating. Reel it in. We build the raft ourselves.
Barrels. Planks. Rope. Piece by piece, the raft grew. Walls. A sail. A fire to cook the fish.
Then the shark came back. Hungry.
Jay grabbed the iron spear. The shark swam off.
But Milo was watching the horizon. A wave. Taller than a house.
The raft climbed the wave, and held.
lines.cap: The raft climbed the wave... and held.

lines.say: That night, the sea went quiet. Something huge rose beside the raft. Looked at them. And sank back down.
At dawn, they found a whirlpool. Players paddle away from it. Milo paddled straight in.
Splash. Back on the bedroom floor. Soaked. Holding a fish.
Blackwater Drift is real, and it's on Pulsebox. Up to four friends on one raft.
lines.cap: Blackwater Drift is real, and it's on PULSEBOX. Up to 4 friends on one raft.

lines.say: Next time, they're not escaping. They're breaking in.
